description: This file declares the GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient class and related message classes, which implement a media player client interface for GStreamer-based media streaming, including buffer pulling, playback state management, and source attachment/detachment.

classes.name: BufferPuller
classes.description: Handles pulling buffers from the media sink and manages a message queue for buffer requests.

classes.name: HaveDataMessage
classes.description: Represents a message indicating data availability for a media source.

classes.name: PullBufferMessage
classes.description: Represents a request to pull buffer data from the media sink.

classes.name: NeedDataMessage
classes.description: Represents a message indicating the need for more media data.

classes.name: PlaybackStateMessage
classes.description: Represents a message about a change in playback state.

classes.name: QosMessage
classes.description: Represents a message containing QoS information for a media source.

classes.name: BufferUnderflowMessage
classes.description: Represents a message indicating a buffer underflow event.

classes.name: AttachedSource
classes.description: Associates a media source with its sink and manages its seeking state and need data requests.

classes.name: GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient
classes.description: Implements a media pipeline client for GStreamer, managing media sources, playback, and buffer handling.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Notifies the client of the media duration.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notifies the client of the current playback position.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Notifies the client of the native video size.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notifies the client of network state changes.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notifies the client of playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Indicates whether video data is available.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Indicates whether audio data is available.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Informs the client that more media data is needed for a source.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Informs the client to cancel media data requests for a source.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Provides QoS information for a media source.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Indicates a buffer underflow event for a source.

methods.name: createBackend
methods.description: Creates the media backend.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the client.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the client.

methods.name: handlePlaybackStateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in playback state.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video rectangle dimensions.

methods.name: getVideoRectangle
methods.description: Retrieves the current video rectangle.

methods.name: requestPullBuffer
methods.description: Requests pulling buffer data for a stream.

methods.name: handleQos
methods.description: Handles QoS updates for a source.

methods.name: handleBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Handles buffer underflow events.

methods.name: notifySourceStartedSeeking
methods.description: Notifies that a source has started seeking.

methods.name: startPullingDataIfSeekFinished
methods.description: Starts pulling data if seeking has finished.

methods.name: stopStreaming
methods.description: Stops streaming media.

methods.name: destroyClientBackend
methods.description: Destroys the media client backend.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame from the sink.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Gets the current volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Returns whether audio is muted.

methods.name: setAudioStreamsInfo
methods.description: Sets information about audio streams.

methods.name: setVideoStreamsInfo
methods.description: Sets information about video streams.
